prd_facts.fact: Only a customer with a delivered or partially refunded order containing the product can review it; others are refused with not_verified_buyer.
A rating is a whole number from 1 to 5 and the text is at most 500 characters; otherwise it is a validation error.
A customer has one review per product; submitting again replaces it and keeps the same review id.
The average rating of a product is the mean of its ratings rounded half up to 1 decimal, or none when there are no reviews.
Reviews of a product are listed newest first.
A review has an id, customer, SKU, rating, optional text, creation date and a verified flag that is always true.
The PRD has a new reviews section with rules REV-01 to REV-05.
